title: Origin payloads and source reads
statement: For a binary machine configuration $c$ with $k$ work tapes on input $x$, the head-centered payload vector at offset $0$ equals the vector of symbols read under the work-tape heads and the input head, with the input boundary tag included.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration of a binary machine with k work tapes on input x
replaced:
For every configuration of a binary machine, the head-centered payload vector at
offset $0$ equals the read vector at the macrostep origin; reading the marked origin
therefore obtains all source reads simultaneously.
